label: No Poverty
description: End poverty in all its forms everywhere including economic inclusion and social protection

label: Zero Hunger
description: End hunger achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture

label: Good Health and Well-being
description: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages including disease prevention

label: Quality Education
description: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities

label: Gender Equality
description: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls including ending discrimination

label: Clean Water and Sanitation
description: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all

label: Affordable and Clean Energy
description: Ensure access to affordable reliable sustainable and modern energy for all

label: Decent Work and Economic Growth
description: Promote sustained inclusive and sustainable economic growth and decent work for all

label: Industry Innovation and Infrastructure
description: Build resilient infrastructure promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation

label: Reduced Inequalities
description: Reduce inequality within and among countries including income and social disparities

label: Sustainable Cities and Communities
description: Make cities and human settlements inclusive safe resilient and sustainable

label: Responsible Consumption and Production
description: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns and resource efficiency

label: Climate Action
description: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts through mitigation and adaptation

label: Life Below Water
description: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans seas and marine resources for sustainable development

label: Life on Land
description: Protect restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems and halt biodiversity loss

label: Peace Justice and Strong Institutions
description: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies provide access to justice and build accountable institutions

label: Partnerships for the Goals
description: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
